description.en: The live streaming domain for which you want to modify the acceleration region.

description.zh:
修改加速区域。
{“coverage”:“overseas”} 指的是该配置面向的是海外区域。下面是对三个支持的coverage值的说明：
- domestic：中国内地。
- overseas：海外及港澳台加速。
- global：全球加速。
description.en:
The acceleration region. A value of {"coverage":"overseas"} specifies that the configuration is for regions outside mainland China. The following list describes the valid values for coverage:

- domestic: mainland China.

- overseas: regions outside mainland China.

- global: regions in and outside mainland China.

title.zh: 修改直播域名加速区域

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 100 queries per second (QPS) per user. API calls that exceed this limit are throttled, which may affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live modify-live-domain-schdm-by-property --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --property coverage_:_global --region cn-hangzhou
